title: Right panel follow-ups: Site changes holds its place while loading, model menu keeps focus, start screen centred, Template default opens the preview, tool tables ignore prototype names
steps: S1: Open Site changes in a 1100x900 wide panel with a slow activity read: first open of a long and a short list, then reopen; record the header top and the loading bar height on every frame.
S2: Open the model menu (real dsh ModelSelect) and press a group heading, the card padding, and the empty 'No models available.' pane.
S3: Render the start screen and measure the hero, cards and composer against the conversation column centre.
S4: Compute the Template default popup action for owner/viewer, worn/bare and undone states.
S5: Ask the subprocess-docker fence tables for a tool or mode named toString, constructor or __proto__.
expect: S1: first open shows only the spinner, then the header at one place on every frame; reopen header at one place; loading bar 2px.
S2: the menu stays open and focus stays inside it.
S3: content centred on the column within 1px.
S4: the way back is labelled from last.previous, off with a reason for a Viewer or once undone, a quiet line when nothing is worn.
S5: no table match; unknown tool or mode; path-like strings still fenced.
evidence: 14/10/2026 on the local Docker stand (tam-wordpress, /activity delayed 2.5 s): Site changes header went 487 -> 334 px while loading; model menu heading click dropped focus to body; Template default card stood taller than its row
fence: Browser e2e and node unit tests; the cowork.tracy.site check happens after deploy, not in this case
